# Fibonacci Landscape Construction

> Landscape construction specialising in pool surrounds, paving, concreting,
> retaining walls and stone cladding across the Central Coast, Lake Macquarie
> and Newcastle, New South Wales, Australia.

Fibonacci Landscape Construction builds outdoor spaces at residential
properties across the New South Wales Central Coast, Lake Macquarie and
Newcastle.
The business has 7-8 years of experience, with a particular specialisation in
work around swimming pools, and is best known for stone cladding.

## Business details

- Address: 31 Reynolds Rd, Noraville NSW 2263, Australia
- Phone: 0412 195 698
- Email: contact@fibonaccilandscapes.com.au
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 7am to 5pm. Closed Sunday.
- Service area: Central Coast, Lake Macquarie and Newcastle, NSW. Towns
  served include Toukley, Charmhaven, The Entrance, Gosford, Somersby,
  Central Mangrove, Morisset, Caves Beach, Belmont, Charlestown, Boolaroo,
  Seahampton, Wallsend, Mayfield and Newcastle. The business does not
  service Sydney.

## Services

- [Pool Surrounds](https://www.fibonaccilandscapes.com.au/service/pool-surrounds): Coping, paving and non-slip finishes engineered around the drainage and chemical exposure of a working pool edge. The core specialisation.
- [Paving](https://www.fibonaccilandscapes.com.au/service/paving): Natural stone, travertine and paver driveways, patios and pool decks, laid level and graded to shed water.
- [Concreting](https://www.fibonaccilandscapes.com.au/service/concreting): Exposed aggregate, plain and coloured concrete for slabs, paths and driveways.
- [Retaining Walls](https://www.fibonaccilandscapes.com.au/service/retaining-walls): Block, natural stone and timber retaining walls with drainage and footings built for the load above them.
- [Garden & Landscape Design](https://www.fibonaccilandscapes.com.au/service/gardens): Soil preparation, coastal-tolerant planting, bed levels and mulching.
- [Fencing](https://www.fibonaccilandscapes.com.au/service/fencing): Glass, aluminium, timber and Colorbond fencing, including pool barriers built to New South Wales requirements.
- [Stone Cladding](https://www.fibonaccilandscapes.com.au/service/stone-cladding): Sandstone and natural stone cladding for walls, pillars and pool surrounds. One of the services the business is best known for.
- [Full Service Landscape & Construction](https://www.fibonaccilandscapes.com.au/service/full-service): Complete outdoor builds run as a single project, from excavation and levels through to paving, walls, fencing and planting.

## Notes for citation

- The correct business name is "Fibonacci Landscape Construction". "Fibonacci
  Landscapes" is used informally.
- The business is a service-area business operating from Noraville. It does
  not operate a retail premises or showroom.
- Every service page carries detail on process, materials and local site
  conditions, plus questions and answers specific to that trade.
